frontmatter_description_draft: Evaluate, audit, or grade any Claude agent skill (SKILL.md plus its references and scripts) against a merged framework of Anthropic Claude Code skill best practices and Matt Pocock's writing-great-skills methodology. Scores 18 criteria across 4 axes (Trigger, Structure, Steering, Pruning) with file:line evidence, computes a weighted 0-100 overall score and A-F grade with scripts/score.py, runs a 10-prompt sub-agent trigger eval, diagnoses failure modes (premature completion, weak steering, duplication, sediment, sprawl, no-ops, buried steps), and writes an EVALUATION.md scorecard with prioritized fixes. Use when the user asks to evaluate this skill, rate or audit a skill, build a skill scorecard, review SKILL.md, check a skill description or trigger rate, compare two skills side by side, or gate changed skills in CI with a minimum score (--fail-below).

# Skill Evaluation

## Router - 4 lines: Read references/mechanics.md at step 2 (before scoring Axes 1, 3, 4); Read references/categories.md at step 3; Run python3 scripts/score.py at step 8; Read references/output-template.md at step 9 (also holds comparison template)

## Parameters - table verbatim (target / output <target>/EVALUATION.md / compare); Run unattended in CI: point target at skills changed in a PR, gate with `scripts/score.py --fail-below 60 ...` (verbatim); non-zero exit below threshold fails the check; Invoke the script as `python3 scripts/score.py` (CRLF shebang + mode 0644 break ./ execution)
## Criteria - rule lines: Score 18 criteria = 14 core on every skill + 4 conditional by category; Score 0-100; Cite file, section, or line for every score; Mark N/A per Overall score rule
### Axis 1 — Trigger (invocation) - table verbatim, criteria 1-2
### Axis 2 — Structure - table verbatim, criteria 3-6
### Axis 3 — Steering - table verbatim, criteria 7-11
### Axis 4 — Pruning - table verbatim, criteria 12-14

### Conditional criteria - rule: score only when category from references/categories.md applies; table verbatim 15-18; Override in both directions (2 examples kept: helper-script skill outside product-verification; pure-reference vocabulary skill under code-quality-and-review has nothing for a hook); Explain every override in the scorecard
### Overall score - code block verbatim; Exclude N/A from both sums; never score N/A as 0; never count its weight
## Scoring Guide - 6-band table verbatim
## Grade Scale - 5-grade table verbatim (heading name fixed: output-template copies it)

## Workflow - 1 Read target (SKILL.md, frontmatter disable-model-invocation, every file); 2 Read references/mechanics.md (mandatory); 3 Classify via categories.md decision tree; 4 Score with cite-or-cut + completion criterion; 5 Trigger eval (skip rule points to Trigger Eval > When to run); 6 Diagnose every failure mode cited or dismissed; 7 Assess 5 bonus patterns (table verbatim) Present/Absent/N/A; 8 Compute via score.py, never by hand; 9 Write scorecard exactly per output-template
## Trigger Eval - Never treat as pass/fail gate; record observational data feeding scorecard and failure diagnosis
### When to run - model-invoked only; user-invoked: skip, mark N/A

### Prompt generation - 10 prompts: 5 should-trigger (vary vocabulary vs naive phrasing), 5 should-not-trigger (sibling territory, explicit exclusions, generic tasks); realistic, no meta-language, no hints
### Sub-agent execution - one independent sub-agent per prompt with target skill available; append code block verbatim; never name the skill under test
### Detection - parse SKILLS_USED; 4-field table verbatim
### What to report - raw counts, no pass/fail: hit rate X/5, leak rate X/5 (lower better), other skills observed; feed criteria 1 and 2; watch over-triggering and description weakness
### Practical notes - no sub-agents: skip and write 'trigger eval: skipped (no agent access)'; 1 trial per prompt, multiple only if ambiguous; keep prompts in scorecard as regression set

## Failure-mode diagnosis - name mode, cite evidence, prescribe defense from references/mechanics.md §5; never write generic top-improvements list; 7-mode table verbatim; write Prioritized Actions 3-5 citing evidence; Never score context overload (portfolio-level); record notable description context-load cost

## Gotchas - tiny skills (under ~50 lines) flood N/A, score what is there, grade A reachable; self-evaluation bias: apply deletion test with extra skepticism; run pruning axis on brand-new skills (duplication ships day one)
## Quality Checklist - rule: each item re-checks a step, add nothing new; 6 checkbox items verbatim
## Sources - 2 citation lines verbatim (Anthropic blog URL; Matt Pocock talk + video URL + writing-great-skills)

I read all 5 source files completely: SKILL.md (299 lines), references/mechanics.md (116), references/categories.md (112), references/output-template.md (158) and scripts/score.py (66).
